fields.community_summary: Park Slope United Methodist Church is an open and affirming community in Brooklyn that welcomes all regardless of sexual orientation, race, or background.
fields.theology_summary: This church emphasizes radical inclusivity and welcomes individuals at any stage of their spiritual journey.
fields.worship_style_detail: Services feature traditional hymns accompanied by a pipe organ and a robe-wearing choir.
fields.pull_quote: No matter where you are on your journey, you are welcome here.

fields.theology_summary: This church believes in the inerrancy of Scripture, salvation by grace through faith, and the autonomy of the local church.
fields.worship_style_detail: Sunday services feature hymnal worship led by piano.
fields.pull_quote: First Baptist Church holds firmly to the inerrancy of Scripture and the historic Baptist Faith and Message.
statement_of_faith: The Bible is God's inspired and inerrant Word.
Salvation is by grace through faith in Christ alone.
Marriage is between one man and one woman.
The local church is autonomous under Christ's headship.

snippets.programs: Active children's ministry, AWANA on Wednesdays, men's and women's Bible studies

fields.community_summary: St. Joseph Catholic Church serves its parish with regular Mass services and various programs for children and adults.
fields.theology_summary: The church celebrates Mass according to the Roman Missal, indicating adherence to traditional Catholic doctrine.
fields.worship_style_detail: Mass is celebrated with the Roman Missal, accompanied by organ and a cantor.
fields.pull_quote: St. Joseph Catholic Church serves the parish with Mass in English on Saturdays at 5pm and Sunday at 8am, and in Spanish on Sundays at 11am and 1pm.

fields.community_summary: Sojourn is a church planted in 2014 in East Austin, meeting in a renovated warehouse.
fields.theology_summary: Sermons feature 35-40 minutes of expository preaching through books of the Bible.
fields.worship_style_detail: Worship is led by a full band with drums, electric guitar, keys, and vocals, featuring original songs and modern arrangements of hymns.
fields.pull_quote: Our worship is led by a full band — drums, electric guitar, keys, and vocals — with original songs and modern arrangements of hymns.

snippets.programs: Programs: Sojourn Kids (newborn through 5th grade), middle and high school youth, men's and women's groups, recovery ministry.
